sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: get_mask(mask_type=output) construction function only; no MaskedLinear forward or MADE model.

sourceFacts: Input degrees use modulo D-1 for hidden units. Output degrees use modulo D then minus1, so output coordinate i can only depend on preceding input degrees.
Comparison result has row=output unit and column=input unit. The float mask is fixed topology, not an attention probability or learned parameter.
This function merely returns a tensor; register_buffer belongs to its MaskedLinear caller. Input/hidden mask types are alternate source branches not mixed into this selected view.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
